name: Lilas
source:
Strengths - Good business sense, open-minded, practical
Weaknesses - Expressing her emotions, aloof

Lilas is the sole owner of a small business based in Oxhabor, where she spends most of her time. When she's not there, she's driving her cart from city to city, delivering goods or meeting contacts.

She tends to keep to herself, and mostly enjoys her own company. Some people tell her that she's not expressive enough, but they tend to not pay enough attention to her to see her true emotions.

Lilas is an unlikely friend to Cyne, who she met many years ago.

[From the developer's [url=https://twitter.com/TwoHalfStudios/status/1152419098292154368/]official Twitter[/url]]
